result.title: GeoART: Geometry-Aware Refinement via Test-Time Scaling for Camera-Conditioned Video Diffusion
result.summary: Camera-conditioned video diffusion models often suffer from inaccurate camera control and geometric inconsisten- cies because camera constraints and estimated geometry are only weakly enforced during denoising. Existing reme- dies often require costly geometry-aware fine-tuning or ad- ditional 3D supervision. We introduce GeoART, a training- free self-refinement framework that improves camera con- trollability through geometry-aware test-time scaling. At selected denoising steps, GeoART generates multiple can- didates within the Predict-and-Perturb cycle and eval- uates them using a geometry prior, without directly modify- ing the denoising trajectory. A confidence gate suppresses unreliable geometric evidence, while rank-calibrated prob- abilistic selection combines score magnitude and relative rank to choose the next refinement state. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in camera controlla- bility, multi-view consistency, and visual quality over exist- ing sampling and self-refinement methods, without training or modifying the pretrained video diffusion model

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练框架 GeoART，在相机条件视频扩散的若干去噪步生成多个候选，用几何先验评估，并以置信门控与秩校准概率选择决定下一精炼状态。
AI.relevance_reason: 其候选生成后的证据评估、置信门控与秩校准选择或可为 latent 推理状态的证据筛选与停止决策提供方法线索，但作用对象是视频扩散去噪轨迹，可迁移性待核查。
